proof_body:
by
  intro 𝕜 _ X _ _ _ T μ hT hμ h
  have hnot : ¬ Module.End.HasEigenvalue (T : Module.End 𝕜 X) μ := by
    intro he
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := he.exists_hasEigenvector
    exact hx.2 (h x (Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp hx.1))
  have hres := (hT.hasEigenvalue_or_mem_resolventSet hμ).resolve_left hnot
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : IsUnit (algebraMap 𝕜 (X →L[𝕜] X) μ - T) := hres
  have hval : ∀ x, (u : X →L[𝕜] X) x = μ • x - T x := fun x => by
    rw [hu]; simp [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  refine ⟨-((u⁻¹ : (X →L[𝕜] X)ˣ) : X →L[𝕜] X), fun y => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · have h1 : (u : X →L[𝕜] X) (((u⁻¹ : (X →L[𝕜] X)ˣ) : X →L[𝕜] X) y) = y := congrArg (fun F => F y) u.mul_inv
    rw [hval] at h1
    change T (-(((u⁻¹ : (X →L[𝕜] X)ˣ) : X →L[𝕜] X) y)) - μ • (-(((u⁻¹ : (X →L[𝕜] X)ˣ) : X →L[𝕜] X) y)) = y
    rw [map_neg, smul_neg]
    calc -T (((u⁻¹ : (X →L[𝕜] X)ˣ) : X →L[𝕜] X) y) - -(μ • ((u⁻¹ : (X →L[𝕜] X)ˣ) : X →L[𝕜] X) y) = μ • ((u⁻¹ : (X →L[𝕜] X)ˣ) : X →L[𝕜] X) y - T (((u⁻¹ : (X →L[𝕜] X)ˣ) : X →L[𝕜] X) y) := by abel
      _ = y := h1
  · have h2 : ((u⁻¹ : (X →L[𝕜] X)ˣ) : X →L[𝕜] X) ((u : X →L[𝕜] X) y) = y := congrArg (fun F => F y) u.inv_mul
    rw [hval] at h2
    change -(((u⁻¹ : (X →L[𝕜] X)ˣ) : X →L[𝕜] X) (T y - μ • y)) = y
    rw [← neg_sub, map_neg, neg_neg, h2]
target_source: ∀ (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (X : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace 𝕜 X] [CompleteSpace X] (T : X →L[𝕜] X) (μ : 𝕜), IsCompactOperator T → μ ≠ 0 → (∀ x : X, T x = μ • x → x = 0) → ∃ R : X →L[𝕜] X, ∀ y, T (R y) - μ • R y = y ∧ R (T y - μ • y) = y
